Which type of tractor has same production in the years 2010 and 2013
solution:
**Given:-** A table presenting production of four different type of tractor between 2010 to 2014

**To find:-** type of tractor has same production in the years 2010 and 2013

**Concept used:-** Checking the data

**Calculation:-** 

Type - A :- In 2010 → 18 and in 2013 → 17

Type - B :- In 2010 → 25 and in 2013 → 23

Type - C :- In 2010 → 12 and in 2013 → 12

Type - D :- In 2010 → 19 and in 2013 → 11

 

It can be observed that in Type - C, the production is same for 2010 and 2013.

 

**.·.Type - C**, type of tractor has same production in the years 2010 and 2013
